method: each claim read against the slide on screen at its cue (key.json slide inventory and style text) and the slide image in suite_a/out/<lecture>/slide_<n>.png; done after the scored run, no model calls
summary: No unsupported claim is about styling, colours, layout or slide numbers: the key covers those (style text, slide inventory), and the one slide-number claim, a03 x001#6 'marked 1 of 4', was judged supported. One claim is a real error (a03 x002#1, chart values read as times); the rest are paraphrases or split-off fragments of on-screen text, which the pre-registered rule counts as unsupported because quoted on-screen text must match exactly, and whole-sentence claims that repeat them.

a03 x001#5.note: Slide 1 bullet 3 reads 'Action and reaction are always paired': the same content in other words; the pre-registered rule wants on-screen text quoted exactly.

a03 x001#7.claim: A slide titled Newton's Three Laws lists three laws: inertia, force causes acceleration, action-reaction pairs; marked 1 of 4
a03 x001#7.note: Repeats claims #1 to #6 of the same cue; unsupported only through #5 (the paraphrase).

a03 x002#1.claim: A slide titled Velocity Over Time shows a line graph of velocity versus time with data points at 0.5 to 8.5 seconds
a03 x002#1.note: The chart 'Speed vs Time' has its points at t=0s to t=8s; 0.5 to 8.5 are their velocities in m/s, not times (slide_2.png). The title, the line chart and its axes are right.

a07 c004#1.note: One word of the slide 2 title 'Temperature and Precipitation', split off by the claim split; the whole title (#3) was judged supported.

a07 c004#2.note: As #1: one word of the slide 2 title; the whole title (#3) was judged supported.

a07 c006#1.note: The framing word of 'Slide: Annual Rainfall by Region', split off as a claim; the rule does not doubt framing words, but the split made it a claim of its own.

a07 c006#2.note: Part of the slide 3 title 'Annual Rainfall by Region' (slide_3.png).

a07 c006#3.note: Part of the slide 3 title 'Annual Rainfall by Region'.

a07 c006#4.note: The last word of the slide 3 title 'Annual Rainfall by Region'.

a07 c006#5.note: Repeats claims #1 to #4 of the same cue: the slide 3 title after the framing word 'Slide:'.
